title: 第3章 钱多多第4章 铁背苍熊
slug: 混沌神体之鸿蒙至尊未命名95
content_zh:
叶辰看着两人修为都是淬体境五重天，现在自己觉醒了记忆，思索出一套适合现在的剑法《逍遥剑法》，加上《追风步》，未必不是这两人的对手。
“想要包裹可以”，叶辰一把将包裹丢向其中一人，脚下使出追风步，叶辰趁其不备，使出逍遥剑法第一式，秋风扫落叶，一剑秒杀了对方。
另一人惊惧道“你杀了我大哥。”
另一人回过神来后，手握一把大刀朝着叶辰扑来，“小子本来只是劫点财，没想到你杀了我大哥，我一定杀了你，为我大哥报仇”。
叶辰提剑挡住了进攻，将对方震飞了出去，自己也不好受，毕竟境界太低，咬着牙随后使出了逍遥剑法中的“有凤来仪”，加上追风步。
叶辰一剑劈飞了土匪的脑袋。
叶辰前世尸山血海的走了过来，对杀了二人丝毫不在意，心中暗自想着，“必须先找个隐蔽的山洞，修炼一下剑法，提升一下修为，然后再出去实战演练。”
落霞山脉，一隐蔽山洞中，一名少年此时汗流浃背，从清晨开始一遍又一遍的修炼着逍遥剑法，逍遥剑法威力强大，目前叶辰只能靠着体力来修炼，发挥不出原本该有的威力，只能当武技来用，不过目前也只能是将剑技修炼到炉火纯青的地步。
逍遥剑法总共十三招，第一式，秋风扫落叶，第二式，有凤来仪，第三式，银蛇出洞，第四式，手托七星，第五式，横扫千军，第六式，神龙回首，第七式，游龙戏凤，第八式，七星映月，第九式，行云流水，第十式，风卷残云，第十一式，疾电穿云，第十二式，狂龙幻影，第十三式，凤舞九天。
叶辰一遍又一遍的刺剑，点剑，劈剑，挂剑，撩剑，抹剑，绞剑，截剑，挑剑，云剑，逍遥剑法已经到了炉火纯青的境界，差一步就登峰造极了。
练完剑法后，体力也透支的差不多了，从包裹中拿出干粮，吃了起来，大概休息了半个时辰。又继续修炼，提升一下境界，不到炼气境就无法使用真气，现在只能运转功法通过灵气淬炼身体，强化经脉。
淬体境一到三重天，强化经脉，血脉，四到六重天，强化血肉，五脏，七到九重天强化骨骼，现在开始冲击淬体境三重天了
叶辰收敛心神，盘膝而坐，口中默念《九转仙诀》，功法越高级，吸收调动的灵气也越多，提炼灵气也就越精纯，如果是其他体质，修炼此功法估计可以提升好几重天了。
叶辰是混沌神体，每一层修炼都是别人的几倍几十倍的能量需求，混沌珠也在吸收着海量的灵气，通过一晚上的修炼，终于到了淬体境二重天巅峰了，混沌珠现在有鸡蛋大小了，不再是一颗珠子了。
普通的淬体境六重天，基本上可以一战了，五重天也可以正面击杀了
叶辰出去转转，运气好的好话找点灵药
“嘭嘭锵锵”
前面有打斗的声音，叶辰施展追风步，迅速的赶到现场，躲到一处小土堆后面观察着情况。
只见三名男子，攻击两名少女
三名男子一看就是青狼帮。

“小妞，跟我们走吧！我们是青狼帮的！我们寨主马上要出关了！回去之后给我们寨主做个压寨夫人吧！哈哈哈”
“呸，我家小姐是落霞郡的郡主的女儿，你们也不撒泡尿照照，你们寨主配吗？”丫鬟怒骂道。
“罗军啊，甭给她们废话，寨主出关后就筑基三重天了，武道世界，实力为尊，先抓住她们，我们就能立功了，寨主赏赐我们一些淬体丹”
叶辰仔细观察着，三人中，两个是淬体境六重天，一个是淬体境五重天，那个小姐是淬体境六重天，丫鬟是淬体境五重天。
那个小姐剑光霍霍，身形飘逸，剑法轻灵，那是黄级剑法《灵汐剑法》。
一身玄衣飘逸，灵动的双眼，面对着两人围攻，竟丝毫不乱，进退有度。
丫鬟这边经过长时间的搏斗，体力不支，青狼帮的罗军渐渐占了上风。
罗军一刀砍中了丫鬟的右臂，丫鬟手中的剑被击落，罗军又一掌拍在丫鬟腹部，丫鬟倒地不起。
罗军也加入了围攻小姐的战斗中，面对三人的围攻，小姐面色着急，眉头紧锁。
叶辰跳了出来高喊道，“几位竟敢围攻我落霞郡郡主之女，当真不把我落霞郡放在眼里”
“谁家的小屁孩也敢管大爷的事，我乃青龙帮第五队的队长，黄天熊，活的不耐烦了敢管大爷的事”
本来马上就拿下了小姐，半路杀出个程咬金，黄天熊气愤至极。
“罗军，你去把这小屁孩杀了，淬体境二重天就学人英雄救美，送他去地府。”
罗军笑着“大哥放心！”
content_en:
Ye Chen saw that both of them were at the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm. Now that he had awakened his memory, he came up with a set of swordsmanship suitable for his current situation, the "Happy Sword Technique" and the "Chasing the Wind Step", so he might not be a match for these two.
"If you want a package, you can." Ye Chen threw the package towards one of them and used the Wind Chasing Step. Taking advantage of his unpreparedness, Ye Chen used the first style of Xiaoyao Sword Technique. The autumn wind swept the fallen leaves and killed the opponent instantly with one sword.
Another person said in horror, "You killed my eldest brother."
After the other person came to his senses, he rushed toward Ye Chen with a big knife in his hand, "Young man, I just wanted to rob some money. I didn't expect you to kill my elder brother. I will definitely kill you to avenge my elder brother."
Ye Chen raised his sword to block the attack and knocked the opponent away. He felt uncomfortable because his level was too low. He gritted his teeth and then used the "Feng Lai Yi" in Xiaoyao Sword Technique, plus the Wind Chasing Step.
Ye Chen chopped off the bandit's head with a sword.
Ye Chen walked over in a sea of corpses and blood. He didn't care at all about killing the two of them. He thought to himself, "We must first find a hidden cave to practice swordsmanship and improve our cultivation level, and then go out to practice in actual combat."
In a hidden cave in the Luoxia Mountains, a young man was sweating profusely. He had been practicing the Xiaoyao Sword Technique over and over again since early morning. The Xiaoyao Sword Technique was very powerful. Currently, Ye Chen could only rely on physical strength to practice it. He could not exert his original power and could only use it as a martial arts. However, at present, he could only practice the sword skills to the point of proficiency.
Xiaoyao Sword Technique has a total of thirteen moves. The first move is the autumn wind sweeping the fallen leaves. The second move is the phoenix coming. The third move is the silver snake coming out of the hole. The fourth move is holding seven stars in the hand. The fifth move is sweeping thousands of troops. The sixth move is the dragon looking back. The seventh move is the dragon playing with the phoenix. The eighth move is seven stars reflecting the moon. The ninth move is flowing clouds and flowing water. The tenth move is wind and lingering clouds. The eleventh move is lightning piercing the clouds. The twelfth move is the phantom of the dragon. The thirteenth move is the phoenix dancing in the sky.
Ye Chen stabbed the sword, touched the sword, split the sword, hung the sword, lifted the sword, wiped the sword, twisted the sword, cut the sword, picked the sword, cloud sword, Xiaoyao swordsmanship over and over again. Xiaoyao's swordsmanship had reached the level of proficiency, and he was just one step away from reaching the peak.
After practicing the swordsmanship, I was almost exhausted. I took out the dry food from the package, ate it, and rested for about half an hour. He continued to practice and improved his level. He could not use the true energy until he reached the Qi refining stage. Now he could only use the spiritual energy to temper the body and strengthen the meridians by running the exercises.
The first to third heavens of the Body Tempering Realm strengthen meridians and blood vessels. The fourth to sixth heavens strengthen flesh and blood and five internal organs. The seventh to ninth heavens strengthen bones. Now we start to attack the third heaven of the Body Tempering Realm.
Ye Chen gathered his mind, sat cross-legged, and recited the "Nine Transformations Immortal Technique" silently. The more advanced the technique, the more spiritual energy absorbed and mobilized, and the purer the spiritual energy will be. If you have other physiques, practicing this technique can probably improve you to several levels.
Ye Chen is a Chaos Divine Body, and each level of cultivation requires several times and dozens of times the energy requirements of others. The Chaos Bead is also absorbing a huge amount of spiritual energy. After a night of practice, he finally reached the peak of the second level of the Body Tempering Realm. The Chaos Bead is now the size of an egg and is no longer a bead.
The ordinary sixth-level body tempering realm can basically fight, and the fifth-level heaven can also be killed head-on.
Ye Chen went out for a walk, and if he was lucky, he could find some elixir.
"Bang bang clang clang"
There was the sound of fighting ahead, Ye Chen used the Wind Chaser Step, quickly rushed to the scene, and hid behind a small mound to observe the situation.
Only three men were seen attacking two girls.
The three men looked like the Green Wolf Gang.
"Girl, come with us! We are from the Qinglang Gang! Our village leader is about to leave seclusion! When we go back, be the wife of our village leader! Hahaha"
"Bah, my lady is the daughter of the princess of Luoxia County. If you don't urinate and take pictures, is your village master worthy of it?" the maid scolded angrily.
"Luo Jun, don't give them nonsense. The leader of the village will build aJi Third Heaven, in the world of martial arts, strength is respected. If we catch them first, we will be able to make a contribution. The leader of the village will reward us with some body tempering pills."
Ye Chen observed carefully that among the three people, two were at the sixth level of the Body Tempering Realm, one was at the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm, the young lady was at the sixth level of the Body Tempering Realm, and the maid was at the fifth level of the Body Tempering Realm.
That young lady's sword was shining brightly, her figure was elegant, and her swordsmanship was light and agile. It was the Huang-level swordsmanship "Lingxi Swordsmanship".
Dressed in elegant black clothes, with smart eyes, facing the siege of two people, he was not at all confused, and his advances and retreats were measured.
After a long struggle on the maid's side, her strength was exhausted, and Luo Jun from the Green Wolf Gang gradually gained the upper hand.
Luo Jun slashed the maid's right arm with his knife, and the sword in the maid's hand was knocked down. Luo Jun slapped the maid in the abdomen with his palm, causing the maid to fall to the ground.
Luo Jun also joined the battle besieging the young lady. Facing the siege of three people, the young lady looked anxious and frowned.
Ye Chen jumped out and shouted, "How dare you attack the daughter of the princess of Luoxia County? They really don't take Luoxia County seriously."
"Who dares to interfere with the uncle's business? I am the captain of the fifth team of the Qinglong Gang, Huang Tianxiong. I am so impatient that I dare to interfere with the uncle's affairs."
He had already captured the young lady right away, but Cheng Yaojin showed up halfway. Huang Tianxiong was extremely angry.
"Luo Jun, go and kill this little brat. In the second level of the Body Tempering Realm, you can learn to be a hero and save the beauty, and send him to the underworld. "
Luo Jun smiled, "Don't worry, brother!" "
